# Lay It Out Your Way

Version 1.19.0 turns the card into a grid you arrange yourself, and stops the map leaving a blank strip below it on wide cards.

## Lay it out your way

- **Four tiles, two columns.** _[#121]_ Compass, radar, history and map used to be three fixed sections whose only setting was their order. They are now separate tiles in a two-column grid, and each one can be half or full width — so the map can sit beside the radar, the history chart beside the compass, or any other arrangement you like.
- **Arranged like a Sections dashboard.** In the editor's Card Layout section, drag a tile to move it and drag its right edge to switch between half and full width. The eye icon hides a tile; the Hidden row brings it back.
- **A map that spans its neighbours.** Drag the bottom edge of a half-width map to stretch it alongside the tiles next to it. It takes their combined height, but never less than your `map_height`.
- **No gaps.** Tiles flow into the next free space, so a hidden tile or a history chart still waiting for data never leaves a hole.

```yaml
card_layout:
  - map: { width: half, span: 2 }
  - radar: { width: half }
  - history: { width: half }
```

## Also in this release

- **The map fills its space on wide cards.** _[#120]_ On cards wider than 600px the map reserved 500px of height but only drew 300px, leaving a blank strip below it. It now draws at the full height, and a `map_height` you set still wins.
- **The history chart uses the room it gets.** Beside a taller tile it now fills the full height instead of keeping a fixed shape, and its scale follows the data instead of always running to 10 — a storm peaking at 4 strikes now fills most of the chart.
- **Compass and radar stay together.** On wide cards they move towards the middle instead of drifting to opposite edges, and on phones they stay side by side.
- Dependency updates, including `maplibre-gl` 6.11.2 → 6.13.0.

## Good to know

`card_layout` replaces `card_section_order`. An existing order is converted automatically and nothing else in your config changes, but on cards wider than 600px the history chart now sits below compass and radar instead of beside them. To put it next to something again, set it to half width in the editor.

Thanks to @532910 for both reports.
